expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第7–17天伸出时间上升约40%，另一方向不变。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 7–17: extend time rises about 40%; the other direction is unchanged.

ground_truth.zh: extend 参数线性增加 0.4；retract 不变。

expected_health_response.zh: 方向特定：受影响方向的证据升级到 WARNING，另一方向证据保持正常。
expected_health_response.en: Direction-specific: evidence for the affected direction escalates to WARNING; the other direction stays normal.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.
